title: Remote queue subscription weights can exhaust server memory
summary:
### Background

NATS is an open source messaging system for cloud, on-premises and edge deployments.

NATS Server uses queue subscription weights to distribute messages across cluster routes and leafnodes.

### Problem Description

An accepted route or leafnode peer could supply a queue weight that caused the server to allocate excessive memory while resolving matching subscriptions. Message delivery could stall, and memory exhaustion could terminate the process. A cluster listener without authentication increases exposure to this issue.

### Affected Versions

The issue is fixed in v2.14.9 and v2.15.2. Earlier versions containing the affected functionality are vulnerable; the first affected version has not been established for this notice.

### Workarounds

Upgrade to a fixed release.

### References
